statement.text:
Is there an almost simple but not simple group which is recognizable by the
isomorphism type of its Gruenberg–Kegel graph?
    Note that if a group G is recognizable by the isomorphism type of its Gruenberg–
Kegel graph, then G is recognizable by its Gruenberg–Kegel graph, and therefore G
is almost simple (P. J. Cameron, N. V. Maslova, J. Algebra, 607 (2022), 186–213).
                                                                          N. V. Maslova
